title: Exact side-tangent radii and polygon reconstruction

blocks.tex:
This chapter finishes the companion converse. The radius is indexed by the
central edge, rather than by a triple of vertices as in the Menger construction.
Every statement here uses the original labelled radius word; equal adjacent
radii are retained. The proof sources are the separately compiled
\texttt{proof/circumedge} snapshot recorded in the reader's
\href{../discrete/proof-provenance.json}{proof provenance}.

blocks.label: st:admissible
blocks.title: Radius differences and admissibility
blocks.body:
For $\rho:\mathbb Z/n\to\mathbb R$, put $c_i=\rho_{i-1}-\rho_i$.
The admissible profiles have $\rho_i>0$ for all $i$, and either all radii are
constant or $c$ has four cyclically ordered entries with signs $+,-,+,-$.
Zero differences are permitted away from these four witnesses.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.SideTangentAdmissible
lean.code:
def SideTangentAdmissible (ρ : ZMod n → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ i, 0 < ρ i) ∧ ((∃ r, ∀ i, ρ i = r) ∨ DFV (radiusDifference ρ) 0)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.radiusDifference
lean.code: def radiusDifference (ρ : ZMod n → ℝ) (i : ZMod n) : ℝ := ρ (i - 1) - ρ i

blocks.label: st:cyclic-labels
blocks.title: Cyclic relabeling and the four ordered witnesses
blocks.body:
The difference word has $\sum_i c_i=0$. A cyclic shift commutes with taking
differences and preserves every finite sum. If $c$ has a DFV window at zero,
then $n\ge4$ and one can choose a starting label $s$ and integers
$0<p<q<r<n$ for which $c_s,c_{s+p},c_{s+q},c_{s+r}$ have signs $+,-,+,-$.
The bijection $k\mapsto s+k$ preserves successors, including the last-to-first seam.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.radiusDifference_shift
lean.code:
lemma radiusDifference_shift (ρ : ZMod n → ℝ) (s i : ZMod n) :
    radiusDifference (fun j ↦ ρ (s + j)) i = radiusDifference ρ (s + i) := by
  simp only [radiusDifference, add_sub_assoc]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.sum_radiusDifference
lean.code:
lemma sum_radiusDifference [NeZero n] (ρ : ZMod n → ℝ) :
    ∑ i, radiusDifference ρ i = 0 := by
  simpa [radiusDifference, sub_eq_add_neg, Finset.sum_add_distrib] using
    sub_eq_zero.mpr (Equiv.sum_comp (Equiv.addRight (-1 : ZMod n)) ρ)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.exists_ordered_shift_of_dfv
lean.code:
lemma exists_ordered_shift_of_dfv {c : ZMod n → ℝ} (h : DFV c 0) :
    ∃ s p q r : ℕ, 0 < p ∧ p < q ∧ q < r ∧ r < n ∧
      0 < c (s : ZMod n) ∧ c ((s + p : ℕ) : ZMod n) < 0 ∧
      0 < c ((s + q : ℕ) : ZMod n) ∧ c ((s + r : ℕ) : ZMod n) < 0 := by
  obtain ⟨i₁, i₂, i₃, i₄, h₁₂, h₂₃, h₃₄, h₄₁, h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄⟩ := h
  exact ⟨i₁, i₂ - i₁, i₃ - i₁, i₄ - i₁, by omega, by omega, by omega, by omega,
    h₁, by simpa only [show i₁ + (i₂ - i₁) = i₂ by omega] using h₂,
    by simpa only [show i₁ + (i₃ - i₁) = i₃ by omega] using h₃,
    by simpa only [show i₁ + (i₄ - i₁) = i₄ by omega] using h₄⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.cyclicLabelEquiv
lean.code:
def cyclicLabelEquiv [NeZero n] (s : ZMod n) : Fin n ≃ ZMod n where
  toFun i := s + (i.val : ZMod n)
  invFun j := ⟨(j - s).val, ZMod.val_lt _⟩
  left_inv i := Fin.ext (by simp [ZMod.val_cast_of_lt i.isLt])
  right_inv j := by simp

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.four_le_of_dfv
lean.code:
lemma four_le_of_dfv {c : ZMod n → ℝ} {a : ℝ} (h : DFV c a) : 4 ≤ n := by
  obtain ⟨i₁, i₂, i₃, i₄, h₁₂, h₂₃, h₃₄, h₄₁, _⟩ := h
  omega

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.cyclicLabelEquiv_apply
lean.code:
@[simp] lemma cyclicLabelEquiv_apply [NeZero n] (s : ZMod n) (i : Fin n) :
    cyclicLabelEquiv s i = s + (i.val : ZMod n) := rfl

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.cyclicLabelEquiv_symm_succ
lean.code:
lemma cyclicLabelEquiv_symm_succ [NeZero n] (s i : ZMod n) :
    (cyclicLabelEquiv s).symm (i + 1) = (cyclicLabelEquiv s).symm i + 1 :=
  (cyclicLabelEquiv s).injective (by
    simp only [cyclicLabelEquiv_succ, Equiv.apply_symm_apply])

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.cyclicLabelEquiv_succ
lean.code:
lemma cyclicLabelEquiv_succ [NeZero n] (s : ZMod n) (i : Fin n) :
    cyclicLabelEquiv s (i + 1) = cyclicLabelEquiv s i + 1 := by
  simp only [cyclicLabelEquiv_apply, Fin.val_add, Fin.val_one', ZMod.natCast_mod,
    Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, add_assoc]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.cyclicLabelEquiv_symm_val
lean.code:
@[simp] lemma cyclicLabelEquiv_symm_val [NeZero n] (s i : ZMod n) :
    ((cyclicLabelEquiv s).symm i).val = (i - s).val := rfl

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.sum_cyclicLabelEquiv
lean.code:
lemma sum_cyclicLabelEquiv [NeZero n] {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M]
    (s : ZMod n) (f : ZMod n → M) :
    ∑ i : Fin n, f (cyclicLabelEquiv s i) = ∑ j : ZMod n, f j :=
  (cyclicLabelEquiv s).sum_comp f

blocks.tex:
The difference sum telescopes because $i\mapsto i-1$ permutes the cyclic labels.
Subtract the first witness index from the other three; their ordered lifts lie
strictly inside one period. Reduction modulo $n$ gives the indicated bijection
and its inverse $j\mapsto(j-s)\bmod n$. Reindex finite sums through this bijection.

blocks.label: st:cyclic-fan
blocks.title: Returning the balanced geometry to its original labels
blocks.body:
A strict tangential fan indexed by $0,\ldots,n-1$ remains a strict tangential fan
on $\mathbb Z/n$ after any cyclic relabeling. Its weighted balance is unchanged.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.isCyclicStrictTangentialFan_of_finite
lean.code:
theorem isCyclicStrictTangentialFan_of_finite [NeZero n] (s : ZMod n)
    {U Y : Fin n → ℂ} (h : IsStrictTangentialFan U Y) :
    IsCyclicStrictTangentialFan (fun i ↦ U ((cyclicLabelEquiv s).symm i))
      (fun i ↦ Y ((cyclicLabelEquiv s).symm i)) := by
  refine ⟨fun i ↦ h.unit_normal _, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    simpa only [cyclicLabelEquiv_symm_succ] using h.normal_cross_pos ((cyclicLabelEquiv s).symm i)
  · intro i
    simpa only [cyclicLabelEquiv_symm_succ] using h.vertex_eq ((cyclicLabelEquiv s).symm i)
  · intro i j hji hjs
    apply h.strict_support
    · exact fun he ↦ hji ((cyclicLabelEquiv s).symm.injective he)
    · intro he
      apply hjs
      apply (cyclicLabelEquiv s).symm.injective
      simpa only [cyclicLabelEquiv_symm_succ] using he
  · intro i
    simpa only [cyclicLabelEquiv_symm_succ] using h.contact_interior ((cyclicLabelEquiv s).symm i)
  · intro i
    simpa only [cyclicLabelEquiv_symm_succ] using h.edge_pos ((cyclicLabelEquiv s).symm i)
  · intro i
    simpa only [cyclicLabelEquiv_symm_succ] using h.edge_ne ((cyclicLabelEquiv s).symm i)
  · intro i j hji hjs
    simp only [cyclicLabelEquiv_symm_succ]
    apply h.cross_support
    · exact fun he ↦ hji ((cyclicLabelEquiv s).symm.injective he)
    · intro he
      apply hjs
      apply (cyclicLabelEquiv s).symm.injective
      simpa only [cyclicLabelEquiv_symm_succ] using he

blocks.tex:
Pull normals and vertices back by the inverse label bijection. Preservation of
successors transports each incidence, edge, contact and strict-support statement;
injectivity transports the exclusions of incident labels. Reindex the sum to
transport the balance equation.

blocks.label: st:support-simple
blocks.title: Strict support implies actual simplicity
blocks.body:
For $n\ge3$, suppose $[P_i,P_{i+1},P_j]>0$ whenever $j\ne i,i+1$.
Then every edge is nonzero, adjacent closed segments meet only at their common
endpoint, and nonadjacent closed segments are disjoint. Thus $P$ is a simple
polygon, and all consecutive triples have positive determinant.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.positiveOrientation_of_strictSupport
lean.code:
lemma positiveOrientation_of_strictSupport [NeZero n] (hn : 3 ≤ n)
    {Y : ZMod n → ℂ} (hY : StrictConvexEdgeSupport Y) :
    ∀ i, 0 < crossR2 (Y (i - 1)) (Y i) (Y (i + 1)) := by
  have : Fact (1 < n) := ⟨by omega⟩
  have h₁ : (1 : ZMod n) ≠ 0 := one_ne_zero
  have h₂ : (2 : ZMod n) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by decide : 0 < 2) ((ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff 2 n).mp h)
    omega
  intro i
  have h := hY (i - 1) (i + 1)
    (fun he ↦ h₂ (by linear_combination he))
    (fun he ↦ h₁ (by linear_combination he))
  simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using h

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.StrictConvexEdgeSupport
Gluck.Discrete.isSimplePolygon_of_strictConvexEdgeSupport
lean.code:
theorem isSimplePolygon_of_strictConvexEdgeSupport {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    (hn : 3 ≤ n) {v : ZMod n → ℂ} (hsupport : StrictConvexEdgeSupport v) :
    IsSimplePolygon v := by
  have : Fact (1 < n) := ⟨by omega⟩
  have h₁ : (1 : ZMod n) ≠ 0 := one_ne_zero
  have h₂ : (2 : ZMod n) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hle := Nat.le_of_dvd (by decide : 0 < 2) ((ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff 2 n).mp h)
    omega
  have hturn : ∀ i, 0 < crossR2 (v i) (v (i + 1)) (v (i + 1 + 1)) := by
    intro i
    apply hsupport
    · intro h
      apply h₂
      linear_combination h
    · intro h
      apply h₁
      linear_combination h
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i hi
    have h := hturn i
    simp [hi, crossR2] at h
  · intro i
    exact consecutive_segments_inter_eq_singleton_of_crossR2_pos (hturn i)
  · intro i j hij hisj hjsi
    apply segment_inter_eq_empty_of_crossR2_pos
    · exact hsupport i j hij.symm hisj.symm
    · exact hsupport i (j + 1) hjsi (by
        intro h
        exact hij (add_right_cancel h).symm)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.segment_inter_eq_empty_of_crossR2_pos
lean.code:
theorem segment_inter_eq_empty_of_crossR2_pos
    {A B C D : ℂ}
    (hC : 0 < crossR2 A B C) (hD : 0 < crossR2 A B D) :
    segment ℝ A B ∩ segment ℝ C D = ∅ := by
  apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
  intro z hz
  rcases hz with ⟨hzAB, hzCD⟩
  rw [segment_eq_image_lineMap] at hzAB hzCD
  rcases hzAB with ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
  rcases hzCD with ⟨s, hs, heq⟩
  have hzero : crossR2 A B (AffineMap.lineMap A B t) = 0 :=
    crossR2_lineMap_self A B t
  have hcross := congrArg (crossR2 A B) heq
  rw [crossR2_lineMap, hzero] at hcross
  have hweight : 0 ≤ 1 - s := by linarith [hs.2]
  by_cases hs0 : s = 0
  · subst s
    simp only [sub_zero, one_mul, zero_mul, add_zero] at hcross
    linarith
  · have hspos : 0 < s := lt_of_le_of_ne hs.1 (Ne.symm hs0)
    have hleft : 0 ≤ (1 - s) * crossR2 A B C :=
      mul_nonneg hweight hC.le
    have hright : 0 < s * crossR2 A B D := mul_pos hspos hD
    linarith

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.consecutive_segments_inter_eq_singleton_of_crossR2_pos
lean.code:
theorem consecutive_segments_inter_eq_singleton_of_crossR2_pos
    {A B C : ℂ} (hcross : 0 < crossR2 A B C) :
    segment ℝ A B ∩ segment ℝ B C = {B} := by
  rw [Set.eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem]
  refine ⟨⟨right_mem_segment ℝ _ _, left_mem_segment ℝ _ _⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro z ⟨hzAB, hzBC⟩
  rw [segment_eq_image_lineMap] at hzAB hzBC
  rcases hzAB with ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
  rcases hzBC with ⟨s, hs, heq⟩
  have hzero : crossR2 A B (AffineMap.lineMap A B t) = 0 :=
    crossR2_lineMap_self A B t
  have hB : crossR2 A B B = 0 := by
    unfold crossR2
    simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im]
    ring
  have hcrossEq := congrArg (crossR2 A B) heq
  rw [crossR2_lineMap, hB, mul_zero, zero_add, hzero] at hcrossEq
  have hs0 : s = 0 := by nlinarith [hs.1]
  simpa [hs0] using heq.symm

blocks.tex:
The next nonincident vertex gives a positive determinant, excluding a zero edge.
An affine combination of two points strictly left of an oriented line remains
strictly left, so its segment cannot meet the segment on the line. For adjacent
segments, take the determinant of their putative common point against the first
edge: positivity at the third vertex forces the second-segment parameter to
vanish. These two cases give exactly the required segment-intersection conditions.

blocks.label: st:ordered-heading
blocks.title: Canonical positive edge headings
blocks.body:
A strictly supported cyclic polygon has lifted edges
$Y_{k+1}-Y_k=L_ke^{i\theta_k}$ with $L_k>0$,
$0<\theta_{k+1}-\theta_k<\pi$, and
$\theta_{k+n}=\theta_k+2\pi$.
Its vertices, edge vectors, lengths and principal turning increments are periodic.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.cyclicEdgeHeading_succ_lt_add_pi
lean.code:
theorem cyclicEdgeHeading_succ_lt_add_pi [NeZero n] {v : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hsimple : IsSimplePolygon v)
    (horient : ∀ i : ZMod n, 0 < crossR2 (v (i - 1)) (v i) (v (i + 1)))
    (k : ℕ) :
    cyclicEdgeHeading v (k + 1) < cyclicEdgeHeading v k + Real.pi := by
  rw [cyclicEdgeHeading_succ]
  simpa [add_comm] using
    add_lt_add_left (cyclicEdgeTurn_mem_Ioo hsimple horient k).2
      (cyclicEdgeHeading v k)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.cyclicEdgeTurn_mem_Ioo
lean.code:
theorem cyclicEdgeTurn_mem_Ioo [NeZero n] {v : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hsimple : IsSimplePolygon v)
    (horient : ∀ i : ZMod n, 0 < crossR2 (v (i - 1)) (v i) (v (i + 1)))
    (k : ℕ) : cyclicEdgeTurn v k ∈ Set.Ioo 0 Real.pi := by
  have hcross := crossR2_cyclicVertex_pos_of_positiveOrientation horient k
  have him : 0 < (cyclicEdge v (k + 1) / cyclicEdge v k).im := by
    rw [cyclicEdge_ratio_im]
    exact div_pos hcross (Complex.normSq_pos.mpr (cyclicEdge_ne_zero hsimple k))
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold cyclicEdgeTurn
    refine lt_of_le_of_ne (Complex.arg_nonneg_iff.mpr him.le) ?_
    intro hzero
    exact (ne_of_gt him) ((Complex.arg_eq_zero_iff.mp hzero.symm).2)
  · unfold cyclicEdgeTurn
    exact Complex.arg_lt_pi_iff.mpr (Or.inr (ne_of_gt him))

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.cyclicEdgeLength
lean.code:
noncomputable def cyclicEdgeLength (v : ZMod n → ℂ) (k : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ‖cyclicEdge v k‖

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.cyclicEdge_length_mul_exp_heading
lean.code:
theorem cyclicEdge_length_mul_exp_heading [NeZero n] {v : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hsimple : IsSimplePolygon v) (k : ℕ) :
    (cyclicEdgeLength v k : ℂ) *
        Complex.exp ((cyclicEdgeHeading v k : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
      cyclicEdge v k := by
  unfold cyclicEdgeLength
  rw [exp_cyclicEdgeHeading_mul_I hsimple k,
    Complex.norm_mul_exp_arg_mul_I]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.cyclicVertex_periodic
lean.code:
theorem cyclicVertex_periodic [NeZero n] (v : ZMod n → ℂ) (k : ℕ) :
    cyclicVertex v (k + n) = cyclicVertex v k := by
  simp [cyclicVertex, Nat.cast_add]

/-! ## Evaluation of the lowest-vertex boundary cut -/

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.cyclicEdgeLength_pos
lean.code:
theorem cyclicEdgeLength_pos [NeZero n] {v : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hsimple : IsSimplePolygon v) (k : ℕ) :
    0 < cyclicEdgeLength v k := by
  unfold cyclicEdgeLength
  exact norm_pos_iff.mpr (cyclicEdge_ne_zero hsimple k)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.cyclicEdgeTurn
lean.code:
noncomputable def cyclicEdgeTurn (v : ZMod n → ℂ) (k : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  Complex.arg (cyclicEdge v (k + 1) / cyclicEdge v k)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.cyclicEdgeHeading_succ
lean.code:
@[simp] theorem cyclicEdgeHeading_succ (v : ZMod n → ℂ) (k : ℕ) :
    cyclicEdgeHeading v (k + 1) =
      cyclicEdgeHeading v k + cyclicEdgeTurn v k := by
  rfl

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.cyclicEdgeHeading_add_n
lean.code:
theorem cyclicEdgeHeading_add_n [NeZero n] {v : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hone : HasPositiveTurningNumberOne v) (k : ℕ) :
    cyclicEdgeHeading v (k + n) =
      cyclicEdgeHeading v k + 2 * Real.pi := by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      simpa [HasPositiveTurningNumberOne] using hone
  | succ k ih =>
      rw [show k + 1 + n = k + n + 1 by omega,
        cyclicEdgeHeading_succ, cyclicEdgeHeading_succ, ih,
        cyclicEdgeTurn_periodic]
      ring

/-! ## Telescoping reconstruction and support sums -/

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.cyclicEdge
lean.code:
def cyclicEdge (v : ZMod n → ℂ) (k : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  cyclicVertex v (k + 1) - cyclicVertex v k

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.cyclicEdge_ne_zero
lean.code:
theorem cyclicEdge_ne_zero [NeZero n] {v : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hsimple : IsSimplePolygon v) (k : ℕ) :
    cyclicEdge v k ≠ 0 := by
  unfold cyclicEdge cyclicVertex
  rw [sub_ne_zero]
  simpa [Nat.cast_add] using (hsimple.1 (k : ZMod n)).symm

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.cyclicEdgeHeading_strictMono
lean.code:
theorem cyclicEdgeHeading_strictMono [NeZero n] {v : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hsimple : IsSimplePolygon v)
    (horient : ∀ i : ZMod n, 0 < crossR2 (v (i - 1)) (v i) (v (i + 1))) :
    StrictMono (cyclicEdgeHeading v) := by
  apply strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ
  intro k
  rw [cyclicEdgeHeading_succ]
  exact lt_add_of_pos_right _ (cyclicEdgeTurn_mem_Ioo hsimple horient k).1

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.cyclicEdge_periodic
lean.code:
theorem cyclicEdge_periodic [NeZero n] (v : ZMod n → ℂ) (k : ℕ) :
    cyclicEdge v (k + n) = cyclicEdge v k := by
  simp [cyclicEdge, cyclicVertex, Nat.cast_add]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.cyclicVertex
lean.code:
def cyclicVertex (v : ZMod n → ℂ) (k : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  v (k : ZMod n)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.cyclicEdgeTurn_periodic
lean.code:
theorem cyclicEdgeTurn_periodic [NeZero n] (v : ZMod n → ℂ) (k : ℕ) :
    cyclicEdgeTurn v (k + n) = cyclicEdgeTurn v k := by
  unfold cyclicEdgeTurn
  rw [show k + n + 1 = (k + 1) + n by omega,
    cyclicEdge_periodic v (k + 1), cyclicEdge_periodic v k]

blocks.tex:
Strict support gives simplicity and positive consecutive determinants.
The principal argument of each edge ratio therefore lies in $(0,\pi)$.
Start with an argument of the first nonzero edge and add these principal turns;
exponentiation reconstructs every edge. The polygonal turning theorem identifies
the sum over one period as exactly $2\pi$, giving the stated lift and all
periodic identities.

blocks.label: st:scaled-support
blocks.title: Positive closed edge scaling retains strict support
blocks.body:
Suppose a cyclic polygon $Y$ has strict edge support, $n\ge3$, $\rho_i>0$,
and a closed cyclic polygon $P$ satisfies
$P_{i+1}-P_i=\rho_i(Y_{i+1}-Y_i)$. Then $P$ also has strict edge support.
More generally this holds for any closed positive-length edge sequence whose
lifted headings strictly increase by less than $\pi$ at each step and advance
by $2\pi$ over a period.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.strictSupport_of_positive_edge_scaling
lean.code:
theorem strictSupport_of_positive_edge_scaling [NeZero n] (hn : 3 ≤ n)
    {P Y : ZMod n → ℂ} (hY : StrictConvexEdgeSupport Y) (ρ : ZMod n → ℝ)
    (hρ : ∀ i, 0 < ρ i) (hedge : ∀ i, P (i + 1) - P i = ρ i • (Y (i + 1) - Y i)) :
    StrictConvexEdgeSupport P := by
  have hs := isSimplePolygon_of_strictConvexEdgeSupport hn hY
  have ho := positiveOrientation_of_strictSupport hn hY
  have ht := hasPositiveTurningNumberOne_of_simple_positiveOrientation hs ho
  refine strictSupport_of_polar P (cyclicEdgeHeading Y)
    (fun k ↦ ρ (k : ZMod n) * cyclicEdgeLength Y k)
    (fun k ↦ mul_pos (hρ _) (cyclicEdgeLength_pos hs k))
    (cyclicEdgeHeading_strictMono hs ho) (cyclicEdgeHeading_succ_lt_add_pi hs ho)
    (cyclicEdgeHeading_add_n ht) ?_
  intro k
  have he : cyclicEdge P k = ρ (k : ZMod n) • cyclicEdge Y k := by
    simpa [cyclicEdge, cyclicVertex, Nat.cast_add] using hedge (k : ZMod n)
  rw [he, ← cyclicEdge_length_mul_exp_heading hs k]
  simp only [Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.real_smul, mul_assoc]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.strictSupport_of_polar
lean.code:
theorem strictSupport_of_polar [NeZero n] (P : ZMod n → ℂ) (θ ℓ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hℓ : ∀ k, 0 < ℓ k) (hmono : StrictMono θ)
    (hgap : ∀ k, θ (k + 1) < θ k + Real.pi)
    (hperiod : ∀ k, θ (k + n) = θ k + 2 * Real.pi)
    (hpolar : ∀ m, (ℓ m : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ m : ℂ) * Complex.I) = cyclicEdge P m) :
    StrictConvexEdgeSupport P := by
  intro a c hca hca1
  set t := (c - a).val
  have hb : ((t : ℕ) : ZMod n) = c - a := ZMod.natCast_rightInverse (c - a)
  have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [h0, Nat.cast_zero] at hb
    exact hca (sub_eq_zero.1 hb.symm)
  have ht1 : t ≠ 1 := by
    intro h1
    rw [h1, Nat.cast_one] at hb
    exact hca1 (by linear_combination hb.symm)
  have htn : t < n := ZMod.val_lt (c - a)
  have hc : cyclicVertex P (a.val + t) = P c := by
    simp [cyclicVertex, t, Nat.cast_add]
  have hleft : 0 < (Complex.exp (((-θ a.val : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * (P c - P a)).im := by
    rw [← hc, show P a = cyclicVertex P a.val by simp [cyclicVertex]]
    exact support_pos_of_polar P θ ℓ hℓ hmono hgap hperiod hpolar a.val (by omega) (by omega)
  have he : (ℓ a.val : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ a.val : ℂ) * Complex.I) = P (a + 1) - P a := by
    simpa [cyclicEdge, cyclicVertex, Nat.cast_add] using hpolar a.val
  have hp : P (a + 1) = P a + (ℓ a.val : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ a.val : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    linear_combination -he
  rw [hp, crossR2_polar_edge]
  exact mul_pos (hℓ a.val) hleft

blocks.tex:
Use the headings of $Y$ and the positive new lengths $\rho_iL_i$.
Relative to edge $k$, a later vertex's signed left-distance is
\[
 \operatorname{Im}\bigl(e^{-i\theta_k}(P_j-P_k)\bigr)
   =\sum_{m=k}^{j-1}\rho_m L_m\sin(\theta_m-\theta_k).
\]
If all angles in this partial sum are at most $\pi$, the summands are
nonnegative and the one at $k+1$ is positive. Otherwise all angles in the
remaining part of the period lie in $(\pi,2\pi)$; closure expresses the same
partial sum as minus that strictly negative remaining sum. Thus every
nonincident vertex is strictly left of the edge. This proves simplicity only
later, and does not assume it for $P$.

blocks.label: st:scaled-closure
blocks.title: Balance is exactly the edge-closure equation
blocks.body:
For any cyclic vectors $Y_i$ and scalars $\rho_i$,
\[
 \sum_i\rho_i(Y_{i+1}-Y_i)=\sum_i(\rho_{i-1}-\rho_i)Y_i.
\]
If $Y$ has strict support, $n\ge3$, the radii are positive and the right-hand
side vanishes, the edge vectors on the left integrate to a closed, simple,
strictly supported polygon $P$ with exactly those edge vectors.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.edgePrimitive_succ
lean.code:
lemma edgePrimitive_succ [NeZero n] (e : ZMod n → ℂ) (hsum : ∑ i, e i = 0)
    (i : ZMod n) : edgePrimitive e (i + 1) - edgePrimitive e i = e i := by
  have hv : (i + 1).val = (i.val + 1) % n := by
    simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, ZMod.natCast_zmod_val] using
      (ZMod.val_natCast n (i.val + 1))
  by_cases hi : i.val + 1 < n
  · simp [edgePrimitive, hv, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hi, Finset.sum_range_succ]
  · have hin : i.val + 1 = n := by have := i.val_lt; omega
    have hs : (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, e (k : ZMod n)) = 0 := by
      simpa only [zero_add] using (sum_range_natCast_add e 0).trans hsum
    have he : (∑ k ∈ Finset.range i.val, e (k : ZMod n)) + e i = 0 := by
      simpa only [← hin, Finset.sum_range_succ, ZMod.natCast_zmod_val] using hs
    simpa only [edgePrimitive, hv, hin, Nat.mod_self, Finset.range_zero,
      Finset.sum_empty, zero_sub] using (neg_eq_iff_add_eq_zero.mpr he)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.sum_scaled_edges
lean.code:
lemma sum_scaled_edges [NeZero n] (ρ : ZMod n → ℝ) (Y : ZMod n → ℂ) :
    ∑ i, ρ i • (Y (i + 1) - Y i) = ∑ i, (ρ (i - 1) - ρ i) • Y i := by
  have he := Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.addRight (1 : ZMod n))
    (fun i ↦ ρ i • Y (i + 1)) (fun j ↦ ρ (j - 1) • Y j) (fun i ↦ by simp)
  simpa only [smul_sub, sub_smul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib] using
    congrArg (fun z : ℂ ↦ z - ∑ i, ρ i • Y i) he

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.edgePrimitive
lean.code:
noncomputable def edgePrimitive [NeZero n] (e : ZMod n → ℂ) (i : ZMod n) : ℂ :=
  ∑ k ∈ Finset.range i.val, e (k : ZMod n)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.exists_strictPolygon_of_balanced_scaling
lean.code:
theorem exists_strictPolygon_of_balanced_scaling [NeZero n] (hn : 3 ≤ n)
    {Y : ZMod n → ℂ} (hY : StrictConvexEdgeSupport Y) (ρ : ZMod n → ℝ)
    (hρ : ∀ i, 0 < ρ i) (hbalance : ∑ i, (ρ (i - 1) - ρ i) • Y i = 0) :
    ∃ P : ZMod n → ℂ,
      (∀ i, P (i + 1) - P i = ρ i • (Y (i + 1) - Y i)) ∧
      StrictConvexEdgeSupport P ∧ IsSimplePolygon P := by
  have hclose : ∑ i, ρ i • (Y (i + 1) - Y i) = 0 :=
    (sum_scaled_edges ρ Y).trans hbalance
  let P := edgePrimitive (fun i ↦ ρ i • (Y (i + 1) - Y i))
  have hedge : ∀ i, P (i + 1) - P i = ρ i • (Y (i + 1) - Y i) :=
    edgePrimitive_succ _ hclose
  have hs := strictSupport_of_positive_edge_scaling hn hY ρ hρ hedge
  exact ⟨P, hedge, hs, isSimplePolygon_of_strictConvexEdgeSupport hn hs⟩

deps.label: st:scaled-support

blocks.tex:
Shift the index in the incoming-vertex sum to obtain the displayed summation by
parts. Define $P_0=0$ and $P_j$ as the sum of preceding edge vectors. For
ordinary successors its difference is the next edge; at the cyclic seam the
zero total sum gives the same identity. Positive scaling preserves strict
support, and strict support supplies simplicity.

blocks.label: st:scaled-polygon
blocks.title: A closed polygon for the original nonconstant radius word
blocks.body:
For positive $\rho$ with $\operatorname{DFV}(\rho_{i-1}-\rho_i,0)$, there are
cyclic normals $U$, strict tangential vertices $Y$, and a simple strictly
supported polygon $P$ satisfying
$P_{i+1}-P_i=\rho_i(Y_{i+1}-Y_i)$ for every original label $i$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.exists_sideTangent_scaledPolygon
lean.code:
theorem exists_sideTangent_scaledPolygon [NeZero n] (ρ : ZMod n → ℝ)
    (hρ : ∀ i, 0 < ρ i) (h : DFV (radiusDifference ρ) 0) :
    ∃ U Y P : ZMod n → ℂ, IsCyclicStrictTangentialFan U Y ∧
      (∀ i, P (i + 1) - P i = ρ i • (Y (i + 1) - Y i)) ∧
      StrictConvexEdgeSupport P ∧ IsSimplePolygon P := by
  obtain ⟨s, p, q, r, hp, hpq, hqr, hr, h₀, h₁, h₂, h₃⟩ :=
    exists_ordered_shift_of_dfv h
  have hn := four_le_of_dfv h
  obtain ⟨U, Y, hfan, hbalance⟩ := exists_balanced_strictTangentialFan hn hp hpq hqr hr
    (fun i ↦ radiusDifference ρ (cyclicLabelEquiv (s : ZMod n) i))
    ((sum_cyclicLabelEquiv (s : ZMod n) (radiusDifference ρ)).trans (sum_radiusDifference ρ))
    (by simpa only [cyclicLabelEquiv_apply, Nat.cast_zero, add_zero] using h₀)
    (by simpa only [cyclicLabelEquiv_apply, Nat.cast_add] using h₁)
    (by simpa only [cyclicLabelEquiv_apply, Nat.cast_add] using h₂)
    (by simpa only [cyclicLabelEquiv_apply, Nat.cast_add] using h₃)
  let U' : ZMod n → ℂ := fun i ↦ U ((cyclicLabelEquiv (s : ZMod n)).symm i)
  let Y' : ZMod n → ℂ := fun i ↦ Y ((cyclicLabelEquiv (s : ZMod n)).symm i)
  have hf : IsCyclicStrictTangentialFan U' Y' := isCyclicStrictTangentialFan_of_finite _ hfan
  have hb : ∑ i, (ρ (i - 1) - ρ i) • Y' i = 0 := by
    calc
      ∑ i, (ρ (i - 1) - ρ i) • Y' i =
          ∑ i : Fin n, radiusDifference ρ (cyclicLabelEquiv (s : ZMod n) i) •
            Y' (cyclicLabelEquiv (s : ZMod n) i) :=
        (sum_cyclicLabelEquiv (s : ZMod n) (fun i ↦ radiusDifference ρ i • Y' i)).symm
      _ = 0 := by simpa only [Y', Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using hbalance
  obtain ⟨P, hedge, hsupport, hsimple⟩ :=
    exists_strictPolygon_of_balanced_scaling (by omega) hf.cross_support ρ hρ hb
  exact ⟨U', Y', P, hf, hedge, hsupport, hsimple⟩

blocks.tex:
Choose the four ordered witnesses by cyclic shifting. Their zero-sum difference
coefficients give a balanced strict tangential fan. Return it to the original
labels, then apply the exact closure and positive-scaling result. All coefficients
and radii remain fixed throughout this construction.

blocks.label: st:three-lines
blocks.title: Three inward tangent-line equations
blocks.body:
For outward unit edge normals $N_i$, the supporting line is
$L_i=\{z:\langle N_i,z-P_i\rangle=0\}$.
The inward circle equations for edge $i$, center $C$ and radius $r$ are
\[
 \langle N_{i-1},P_i-C\rangle
 =\langle N_i,P_i-C\rangle
 =\langle N_{i+1},P_{i+1}-C\rangle=r.
\]
The previous line may be based at $P_i$ since it contains that vertex.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.ThreeLineCircle
Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.supportingLine
lean.code:
def supportingLine (P N : ZMod n → ℂ) (i : ZMod n) : Set ℂ :=
  {z | ⟪N i, z - P i⟫_ℝ = 0}

blocks.label: st:realization
blocks.title: Exact side-tangent realization
blocks.body:
A realization of a positive radius word $\rho$ consists of a simple strictly
supported polygon $P$, outward unit normals $N$ with
$P_{i+1}-P_i=\ell_i iN_i$ and $\ell_i>0$, and centers $C_i$.
Every polygon vertex is in the inward closed half-plane of each support.
At edge $i$ the three equations hold with $(C_i,\rho_i)$, and their solution
is unique in both center and signed radius. Moreover
$C_i+\rho_iN_i\in(P_i,P_{i+1})$.
Neighboring contacts are permitted on supporting-line extensions; no condition
is imposed that all these circles lie inside every other supporting half-plane.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.RealizesSideTangent
lean.code:
def RealizesSideTangent [NeZero n] (ρ : ZMod n → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ P N C : ZMod n → ℂ, IsSideTangentRealization ρ P N C

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.IsSideTangentRealization
lean.code:
structure IsSideTangentRealization [NeZero n] (ρ : ZMod n → ℝ)
    (P N C : ZMod n → ℂ) : Prop where
  radius_pos : ∀ i, 0 < ρ i
  simple : IsSimplePolygon P
  strict_convex : StrictConvexEdgeSupport P
  unit_normal : ∀ i, ‖N i‖ = 1
  oriented_edge : ∀ i, ∃ ℓ : ℝ, 0 < ℓ ∧ P (i + 1) - P i = ℓ • (Complex.I * N i)
  supporting : ∀ i j, ⟪N i, P j - P i⟫_ℝ ≤ 0
  circles : ∀ i, ThreeLineCircle P N i (C i) (ρ i)
  unique_circle : ∀ i D r, ThreeLineCircle P N i D r → D = C i ∧ r = ρ i
  central_contact : ∀ i, C i + ρ i • N i ∈ openSegment ℝ (P i) (P (i + 1))

blocks.label: st:circle-identification
blocks.title: The exact three-line circle and its uniqueness
blocks.body:
Suppose $\langle u,x\rangle=\langle v,x\rangle=\langle w,y\rangle=1$,
$[u,v]\ne0$, $\langle w,x\rangle<1$, and $q-p=r(y-x)$.
Then $C=p-rx$ solves the inward equations for the three lines with normals
$u,v,w$ based at $p,p,q$, with radius $r$, and this pair $(C,r)$ is unique.
If $v\in(x,y)$, its central contact $p+r(v-x)$ lies in $(p,q)$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.threeLineCircle_equations
lean.code:
lemma threeLineCircle_equations {u v w x y p q : ℂ} {r : ℝ}
    (hux : ⟪u, x⟫_ℝ = 1) (hvx : ⟪v, x⟫_ℝ = 1) (hwy : ⟪w, y⟫_ℝ = 1)
    (hedge : q - p = r • (y - x)) :
    ⟪u, p - (p - r • x)⟫_ℝ = r ∧ ⟪v, p - (p - r • x)⟫_ℝ = r ∧
      ⟪w, q - (p - r • x)⟫_ℝ = r := by
  have hnext : q - (p - r • x) = r • y := by
    calc
      q - (p - r • x) = (q - p) + r • x := by abel
      _ = r • y := by rw [hedge, smul_sub]; abel
  simp only [sub_sub_cancel, hnext, real_inner_smul_right, hux, hvx, hwy, mul_one, and_self]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.threeLineCircle_unique
lean.code:
theorem threeLineCircle_unique {u v w x y p q C : ℂ} {r ρ : ℝ}
    (hcross : crossR2 0 u v ≠ 0) (hux : ⟪u, x⟫_ℝ = 1) (hvx : ⟪v, x⟫_ℝ = 1)
    (hwy : ⟪w, y⟫_ℝ = 1) (hwx : ⟪w, x⟫_ℝ < 1)
    (hedge : q - p = r • (y - x))
    (hC₁ : ⟪u, p - C⟫_ℝ = ρ) (hC₂ : ⟪v, p - C⟫_ℝ = ρ)
    (hC₃ : ⟪w, q - C⟫_ℝ = ρ) : C = p - r • x ∧ ρ = r := by
  have hcenter : C = p - ρ • x := by
    have hz : p - C - ρ • x = 0 := eq_zero_of_two_inner_eq_zero hcross
      (by rw [inner_sub_right, hC₁, real_inner_smul_right, hux]; ring)
      (by rw [inner_sub_right, hC₂, real_inner_smul_right, hvx]; ring)
    linear_combination -hz
  have heq : q - C = r • y + (ρ - r) • x := by
    rw [hcenter]
    calc
      q - (p - ρ • x) = (q - p) + ρ • x := by abel
      _ = r • y + (ρ - r) • x := by rw [hedge, smul_sub, sub_smul]; abel
  rw [heq, inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_smul_right, hwy] at hC₃
  have hr : ρ = r := by nlinarith
  exact ⟨hr ▸ hcenter, hr⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.prescribedContact_mem_openSegment
lean.code:
lemma prescribedContact_mem_openSegment {u x y p q : ℂ} (r : ℝ)
    (hedge : q - p = r • (y - x)) (hu : u ∈ openSegment ℝ x y) :
    p + r • (u - x) ∈ openSegment ℝ p q := by
  obtain ⟨s, t, hs, ht, hst, he⟩ := hu
  refine ⟨s, t, hs, ht, hst, ?_⟩
  have hq : q = p + r • (y - x) := by rw [← hedge]; abel
  rw [hq, ← he]
  match_scalars
  · exact hst
  · ring
  · linear_combination -r * hst

deps.title: Interior contacts and positive tangent edges
deps.label: st:interior-contact

blocks.tex:
The center displacements from $p,q$ are $rx,ry$, proving the three equations.
Any competing solution $(D,s)$ has $D=p-sx$, since the first two normals are
linearly independent. The third equation becomes
$r+(s-r)\langle w,x\rangle=s$, so strict support forces $s=r$ and $D=C$.
An affine map $z\mapsto p+r(z-x)$ transports the positive barycentric
coordinates of the central contact to the prescribed edge.

blocks.label: st:outward-normals
blocks.title: The edge normals really support the realized polygon
blocks.body:
For $B-A=\ell iu$, one has $[A,B,C]=-\ell\langle u,C-A\rangle$.
Consequently positive oriented edges and strict support imply the outward
normal inequalities $\langle N_i,P_j-P_i\rangle\le0$ for every $i,j$.
A strict fan satisfies its two incident tangent equations; when $n\ge3$ its
next normal obeys $\langle U_{i+2},Y_i\rangle<1$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.normal_support_of_strictSupport
lean.code:
lemma normal_support_of_strictSupport [NeZero n] {P N : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hs : StrictConvexEdgeSupport P)
    (he : ∀ i, ∃ ℓ : ℝ, 0 < ℓ ∧ P (i + 1) - P i = ℓ • (Complex.I * N i)) :
    ∀ i j, ⟪N i, P j - P i⟫_ℝ ≤ 0 := by
  intro i j
  obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓ, hedge⟩ := he i
  have hc := crossR2_tangent_edge (C := P j) hedge
  by_cases hji : j = i
  · simp [hji]
  by_cases hjs : j = i + 1
  · have hz : crossR2 (P i) (P (i + 1)) (P j) = 0 := by simp [hjs, crossR2, mul_comm]
    nlinarith
  · have hp := hs i j hji hjs
    nlinarith

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.IsCyclicStrictTangentialFan.inner_left
lean.code:
lemma IsCyclicStrictTangentialFan.inner_left [NeZero n] {U Y : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (h : IsCyclicStrictTangentialFan U Y) (i : ZMod n) : ⟪U i, Y i⟫_ℝ = 1 := by
  rw [h.vertex_eq i]
  exact inner_tangentIntersection_left (h.unit_normal i)
    (normal_pair_denominator_pos (h.unit_normal i) (h.unit_normal (i + 1))
      (h.normal_cross_pos i)).ne'

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.crossR2_tangent_edge
lean.code:
lemma crossR2_tangent_edge {A B C u : ℂ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (he : B - A = ℓ • (Complex.I * u)) :
    crossR2 A B C = -ℓ * ⟪u, C - A⟫_ℝ := by
  rw [crossR2, he]
  simp only [Complex.smul_re, Complex.smul_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im,
    Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, zero_mul, one_mul, zero_sub, zero_add,
    Complex.inner, Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im]
  ring

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.IsCyclicStrictTangentialFan.next_strict
lean.code:
lemma IsCyclicStrictTangentialFan.next_strict [NeZero n] (hn : 3 ≤ n)
    {U Y : ZMod n → ℂ} (h : IsCyclicStrictTangentialFan U Y) (i : ZMod n) :
    ⟪U (i + 1 + 1), Y i⟫_ℝ < 1 := by
  have : Fact (1 < n) := ⟨by omega⟩
  have h₁ : (1 : ZMod n) ≠ 0 := one_ne_zero
  have h₂ : (2 : ZMod n) ≠ 0 := by
    intro he
    have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by decide : 0 < 2) ((ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff 2 n).mp he)
    omega
  exact h.strict_support i (i + 1 + 1) (fun he ↦ h₂ (by linear_combination he))
    (fun he ↦ h₁ (by linear_combination he))

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.IsCyclicStrictTangentialFan.inner_right
lean.code:
lemma IsCyclicStrictTangentialFan.inner_right [NeZero n] {U Y : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (h : IsCyclicStrictTangentialFan U Y) (i : ZMod n) : ⟪U (i + 1), Y i⟫_ℝ = 1 := by
  rw [h.vertex_eq i]
  exact inner_tangentIntersection_right (h.unit_normal (i + 1))
    (normal_pair_denominator_pos (h.unit_normal i) (h.unit_normal (i + 1))
      (h.normal_cross_pos i)).ne'

deps.title: The two tangent equations and their continuous extension
deps.label: st:tangent-equations

blocks.tex:
Expand the determinant for the identity. Nonincident vertices give a strict
inequality of the required sign; the edge endpoints give equality.
The two tangent equations follow from the vertex formula. Since $n\ge3$,
$i+2$ is neither $i$ nor $i+1$, and the last inequality is one of the
strict nonincident support inequalities.

blocks.label: st:scaled-realization
blocks.title: Scaled tangential geometry realizes the radii
blocks.body:
Let $n\ge3$, let $\rho_i>0$, and let $(U,Y)$ be a strict tangential fan.
If $P$ is a simple strictly supported polygon with
$P_{i+1}-P_i=\rho_i(Y_{i+1}-Y_i)$, then it realizes the exact side-tangent radii
$\rho_i$, with
\[
 N_i=U_{i+1},\qquad C_i=P_i-\rho_iY_i.
\]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.realizesSideTangent_of_scaledFan
lean.code:
theorem realizesSideTangent_of_scaledFan [NeZero n] (hn : 3 ≤ n)
    (ρ : ZMod n → ℝ) (hρ : ∀ i, 0 < ρ i) {U Y P : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hf : IsCyclicStrictTangentialFan U Y)
    (hedge : ∀ i, P (i + 1) - P i = ρ i • (Y (i + 1) - Y i))
    (hs : StrictConvexEdgeSupport P) (hp : IsSimplePolygon P) : RealizesSideTangent ρ := by
  let N : ZMod n → ℂ := fun i ↦ U (i + 1)
  let C : ZMod n → ℂ := fun i ↦ P i - ρ i • Y i
  have he : ∀ i, ∃ ℓ : ℝ, 0 < ℓ ∧ P (i + 1) - P i = ℓ • (Complex.I * N i) := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓ, heq⟩ := hf.edge_pos i
    exact ⟨ρ i * ℓ, mul_pos (hρ i) hℓ, by rw [hedge i, heq, smul_smul]⟩
  refine ⟨P, N, C, hρ, hp, hs, fun i ↦ hf.unit_normal (i + 1), he,
    normal_support_of_strictSupport hs he, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    simpa only [ThreeLineCircle, N, C, sub_add_cancel] using
      threeLineCircle_equations (hf.inner_left i) (hf.inner_right i) (hf.inner_right (i + 1))
        (hedge i)
  · intro i D r hD
    have heq : ⟪U i, P i - D⟫_ℝ = r ∧ ⟪U (i + 1), P i - D⟫_ℝ = r ∧
        ⟪U (i + 1 + 1), P (i + 1) - D⟫_ℝ = r := by
      simpa only [ThreeLineCircle, N, sub_add_cancel] using hD
    exact threeLineCircle_unique (hf.normal_cross_pos i).ne'
      (hf.inner_left i) (hf.inner_right i) (hf.inner_right (i + 1)) (hf.next_strict hn i)
      (hedge i) heq.1 heq.2.1 heq.2.2
  · intro i
    have hc := prescribedContact_mem_openSegment (ρ i) (hedge i) (hf.contact_interior i)
    simpa only [C, N, smul_sub, sub_add_eq_add_sub, add_sub_assoc] using hc

deps.label: st:outward-normals

deps.title: The exact three-line circle and its uniqueness
deps.label: st:circle-identification

blocks.tex:
The fan's positive tangent edge lengths become positive lengths after multiplication
by $\rho_i$, and the normal-support lemma gives the outward half-planes.
Use the circle-identification lemma with
$(u,v,w,x,y,p,q,r)=(U_i,U_{i+1},U_{i+2},Y_i,Y_{i+1},P_i,P_{i+1},\rho_i)$.
It gives the three equations, unique center and radius, and the required open
central contact simultaneously at every label.

blocks.label: st:constant-case
blocks.title: The constant radius case
blocks.body:
For $n\ge4$ and a constant positive word $\rho_i=r$, a side-tangent realization
exists. The normals may be taken at the equally spaced angles $2\pi i/n$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.exists_strictTangentialFan_of_four_le
lean.code:
theorem exists_strictTangentialFan_of_four_le {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : 4 ≤ n) :
    ∃ U Y : Fin n → ℂ, IsStrictTangentialFan U Y := by
  have h := projective_squareFan_isStrictTangentialFan (n := n) (p := 1) (q := 2) (r := 3)
    hn (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by omega) (η := 1) zero_lt_one le_rfl
    (a := 0) (σ := 1) (by simp) zero_lt_one (by simp)
    (by intro i; simp [ProjectiveBall.denominator])
  exact ⟨_, _, h⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.sideTangentConverse_of_const
lean.code:
theorem sideTangentConverse_of_const [NeZero n] (hn : 4 ≤ n) (ρ : ZMod n → ℝ)
    (hρ : ∀ i, 0 < ρ i) {r : ℝ} (hconst : ∀ i, ρ i = r) : RealizesSideTangent ρ := by
  obtain ⟨U, Y, hf⟩ := exists_strictTangentialFan_of_four_le hn
  let U' : ZMod n → ℂ := fun i ↦ U ((cyclicLabelEquiv (0 : ZMod n)).symm i)
  let Y' : ZMod n → ℂ := fun i ↦ Y ((cyclicLabelEquiv (0 : ZMod n)).symm i)
  have hf' : IsCyclicStrictTangentialFan U' Y' := isCyclicStrictTangentialFan_of_finite _ hf
  have hb : ∑ i, (ρ (i - 1) - ρ i) • Y' i = 0 := by
    simp only [hconst, sub_self, zero_smul, Finset.sum_const_zero]
  obtain ⟨P, he, hs, hp⟩ :=
    exists_strictPolygon_of_balanced_scaling (by omega) hf'.cross_support ρ hρ hb
  exact realizesSideTangent_of_scaledFan (by omega) ρ hρ hf' he hs hp

blocks.body:
If $|u|=1$, $r\ge0$, and $\langle u,A-C\rangle=r$, then
\[
 \{z:|z-C|=r\}\cap\{z:\langle u,z-A\rangle=0\}=\{C+ru\}.
\]
Thus every realized circle meets each of its three actual supporting lines at
exactly one point $C_i+\rho_iN_k$, for $k=i-1,i,i+1$.

lemma IsSideTangentRealization.normal_edge_orthogonal [NeZero n]
    {ρ : ZMod n → ℝ} {P N C : ZMod n → ℂ} (h : IsSideTangentRealization ρ P N C)
    (i : ZMod n) : ⟪N i, P (i + 1) - P i⟫_ℝ = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨ℓ, _, he⟩ := h.oriented_edge i
  rw [he, real_inner_smul_right]
  have hz : ⟪N i, Complex.I * N i⟫_ℝ = 0 := by simp [Complex.inner, mul_comm]
  rw [hz, mul_zero]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.IsSideTangentRealization.tangent_sphere
lean.code:
theorem IsSideTangentRealization.tangent_sphere [NeZero n]
    {ρ : ZMod n → ℝ} {P N C : ZMod n → ℂ} (h : IsSideTangentRealization ρ P N C)
    (i k : ZMod n) (hk : k = i - 1 ∨ k = i ∨ k = i + 1) :
    Metric.sphere (C i) (ρ i) ∩ supportingLine P N k = {C i + ρ i • N k} :=
  sphere_inter_normalLine (h.unit_normal k) (h.radius_pos i).le (h.circle_line_distance i k hk)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.IsSideTangentRealization.circle_line_distance
lean.code:
lemma IsSideTangentRealization.circle_line_distance [NeZero n]
    {ρ : ZMod n → ℝ} {P N C : ZMod n → ℂ} (h : IsSideTangentRealization ρ P N C)
    (i k : ZMod n) (hk : k = i - 1 ∨ k = i ∨ k = i + 1) :
    ⟪N k, P k - C i⟫_ℝ = ρ i := by
  rcases hk with hk | hk | hk
  · rw [hk]
    have hz : ⟪N (i - 1), P i - P (i - 1)⟫_ℝ = 0 := by
      simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using h.normal_edge_orthogonal (i - 1)
    rw [show P (i - 1) - C i = (P i - C i) - (P i - P (i - 1)) by abel,
      inner_sub_right, (h.circles i).1, hz, sub_zero]
  · simpa only [hk] using (h.circles i).2.1
  · simpa only [hk] using (h.circles i).2.2

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.sphere_inter_normalLine
lean.code:
lemma sphere_inter_normalLine {u A C : ℂ} {r : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hd : ⟪u, A - C⟫_ℝ = r) :
    Metric.sphere C r ∩ {z | ⟪u, z - A⟫_ℝ = 0} = {C + r • u} := by
  ext z
  simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Metric.mem_sphere, dist_eq_norm, Set.mem_ofPred_eq,
    Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hz, hl⟩
    have hi : ⟪u, z - C⟫_ℝ = r := by
      rw [show z - C = (z - A) + (A - C) by abel, inner_add_right, hl, hd, zero_add]
    have hnorm : ‖(z - C) - r • u‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by
      rw [norm_sub_sq_real, hz, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hr, hu,
        mul_one, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_comm u (z - C), hi]
      ring
    have hzero := norm_eq_zero.mp (sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hnorm)
    linear_combination hzero
  · rintro rfl
    constructor
    · simp [hu, abs_of_nonneg hr]
    · rw [show C + r • u - A = r • u - (A - C) by abel, inner_sub_right,
        real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hu, hd]
      ring

blocks.tex:
For a point in the intersection, $\langle u,z-C\rangle=r$, and expansion gives
$|(z-C)-ru|^2=|z-C|^2+r^2-2r\langle u,z-C\rangle=0$.
Conversely $C+ru$ satisfies both equations. Each polygon edge is perpendicular
to its normal, so the previous line can be based at $P_{i-1}$ or $P_i$ without
changing its signed-distance equation. Apply the identity to all three lines.
